### usb-backup-daily.service
[Unit]
Description=USB Backup (daily)

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/usb-backup-cli run --quiet-skip --config "/etc/usb backup"
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=idle
TimeoutStartSec=12h

### usb-backup-daily.timer
[Unit]
Description=USB Backup (daily)

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
